candidates.reason: Pure validation, request mapping, and response mapping have one semantic owner and no await or lock policy.
The public concepts match, but runtime sharing would couple cancellation, locking, ownership, and close semantics.
Wire behavior is exact while I/O and cleanup must remain native to each execution model.

counterexamples: sync close waits admitted operations with a thread condition
async close must survive leader cancellation and remain completable
decisionRecord.reviewTrigger: public signature, cancellation, locking, transport, or close-policy change
decisionRecord.verdict: intentional separation with shared kernel and parity oracle
